_doc: Reader discounts our partner links give (read by add_aeo.py). Show a code only after opening our own link and seeing the partner apply it. 'auto' = our link applies it by itself. 'benefit' is printed only when the amount was seen at the partner; null keeps the line to what was seen. A code older than recheck_days stops showing at the next build.

holafly.evidence: Opened our Impact link on 2026-11-20: esim.holafly.com showed 'discount code applied: TRAVELNOWAGENT' and said the final price is shown at checkout.
